title: mail: Email/set create (POST via JMAP)
description:
Implement Email/set create in crates/mail/src/email/set.rs: accept a JMAP EmailSubmission-like Email object (mailboxIds → Newsgroups header, from, subject, textBody), construct a valid RFC 5322 article, run through the core POST pipeline (sign with operator key, write to IPFS, append to group log, publish to gossipsub). Return created Email object with id=CID on success, setError on failure.

Why: compose-and-send is a core JMAP capability; reusing the core POST pipeline avoids duplicating signing and storage logic.

Acceptance: Email/set create for comp.test produces a CID, which Email/get then returns with the correct subject.
